name: reel-engineer
note: 30s vertical reel. Gameplay is a real Albert Park session; the panel is the real overlay against a replayed race, which the disclosure says on every frame.
disclosure: Gameplay is real · the panel is the real app on a synthetic race

beats.title: A race engineer that reads your telemetry.
beats.sub: It listens to the UDP feed your game already broadcasts, and runs the maths on your own PC.

beats.title: It ranks the plans, not the stopwatch.
beats.sub: Projected finishing position first — pit loss, undercut maths and the compound rule included.

beats.title: And it speaks first.
beats.sub: Rival stops as they happen. A car closing behind. Damage. Safety-car deltas.

beats.title: Every number computed locally.
beats.sub: Deterministic code does the maths. The model is only allowed to say it out loud.

end_card.title: A real race engineer for F1 25
end_card.note: Your telemetry, your database and your raw traces stay on your PC.
